name: 808 Distorted
author: DAW project (synthesized)
desc: Saturated 808 bass with harmonics that stay audible on phones/laptops (~4 s). Trap/drill/hard hip-hop: play the bassline in MIDI 24-48, long notes on the kick, glide 0.05-0.15 with overlapping notes for slides. Mono. | 808 recipe: slide = glide 0.06-0.15 and let the next note start before the previous ends (overlap ~1/16); glidecurve 0.5 = even, 0.8-1 = late trap/drill slide; release (x0.08 s tail) 0.35 = short knock, 2.5 = trap, 4+ = long boom. Always mono and centred (sub safe).
